title: fix: move agent pricing note to legend
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves the agent-specific pricing explanation below the model list.
- Reuses the existing pricing legend styling and keeps the note visible only on the Agents tab.
- Removes the large pricing notice above the agent rows.

Checks: `npm --prefix enter.pollinations.ai run typecheck`

gist.headline: Pricing note found its shelf
gist.blurb: The Agents tab put its pricing explanation where people already look for legends. Twelve lines of very large notice have been peacefully returned to the soil.
gist.summary: Moved the agent-specific pricing explanation from above the agent model rows into the existing pricing legend, where it appears only on the Agents tab.
gist.impact: Users browsing agent models get the same pricing context in a quieter, more consistent place without a large notice interrupting the table.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tidies a cozy model-directory garden, carefully moving a small pricing-note sign from the middle of a path to a neat legend board beside the Agents-only flower bed. A tiny CRT monitor robot can point eagerly at the organized legend, while code-plants and labeled model rows make the UI context clear.
